turns.q: Can I reroute the package to a different address?
turns.replyTail:
once an order has been charged and confirmed, the delivery address cannot be changed for that order, so a package cannot be rerouted to a different address in transit. If you update your address in your account now, it will only apply to future orders, not the one already on the way.
